content:
Forlinx Embedded FET-MX952x-C SoM and its matching OK-MX952x-C development kit are built around the NXP i.MX 952 Edge AI SoC. Designed for industrial and automotive applications, the processor features four Cortex-A55 cores, a Cortex-M7 real-time core, a Cortex-M33 safety core, and an integrated 2 eTOPS NPU for edge AI workloads. Forlinx FET-MX952x-C SoM The SoM supports up to 8GB LPDDR4X RAM, 64GB eMMC storage, dual Gigabit Ethernet with TSN support, three CAN FD interfaces, and PCIe Gen 3 connectivity. It is designed for industrial automation, machine vision, smart displays, and automotive applications. FET-MX952x-C specifications: SoC – NXP i.MX 952 CPU 4x Arm Cortex-A55 cores @ up to 1.7 GHz 1x Arm Cortex-M7 real-time core @ 800 MHz 1x Arm Cortex-M33 safety core @ 333 MHz GPU – Arm Mali-G310 with OpenGL ES 3.2, Vulkan 1.2, and OpenCL 3.0 support VPU H.264/H.265 hardware decoding up to 4K @ 60fps H.264 hardware [...]
